items.title_cn: 通往代理浏览器之路：Kitesurf更新
items.title_en: The road to the agentic browser: A Kitesurf update
items.title_original: The road to the agentic browser: A Kitesurf update
items.what_happened: Cloudflare更新了Kitesurf，这是一款完全运行在Cloudflare Workers上的代理时代浏览器，新增了WebMCP支持和其他改进。
items.what_happened_en: Cloudflare updated Kitesurf, a browser for the agentic age that runs entirely on Cloudflare Workers, adding WebMCP support and other improvements.
items.why_it_matters: WebMCP支持让开发者能够将网站功能直接暴露给代理，使程序化浏览不再那么脆弱。
items.why_it_matters_en: WebMCP support lets developers expose site functionality directly to agents, making browsing less fragile for programmatic use.

items.title_cn: 由肌肉细胞驱动，纸一样薄的机器人游过水迷宫
items.title_en: Powered by muscle cells, a paper-thin robot swims through watery maze
items.title_original: Powered by muscle cells, a paper-thin robot swims through watery maze
items.what_happened: 麻省理工学院工程师制造了一个由肌肉细胞驱动的纸一样薄的aquabot，它可以游过水迷宫。
items.what_happened_en: MIT engineers built a paper-thin aquabot powered by muscle cells that swims through a watery maze.
items.why_it_matters: 该aquabot为设计小型、高效的生物混合机器人提供了一种方法。
items.why_it_matters_en: The aquabot offers a way to design small, efficient biohybrid robots.

items.title_cn: 新配方帮助RNA疫苗耐受高温
items.title_en: New formulation helps RNA vaccines withstand high temperatures
items.title_original: New formulation helps RNA vaccines withstand high temperatures
items.what_happened: 麻省理工学院工程师找到了一种稳定用于递送RNA疫苗的脂质纳米颗粒的方法，这可能帮助疫苗耐受高温。
items.what_happened_en: MIT engineers have found a way to stabilize the lipid nanoparticles used to deliver RNA vaccines, which could help the vaccines withstand high temperatures.
items.why_it_matters: 稳定用于递送RNA疫苗的脂质纳米颗粒，可能使疫苗更能耐受高温。
items.why_it_matters_en: Stabilizing the lipid nanoparticles used to deliver RNA vaccines could make them more resilient to high temperatures.

items.title_cn: “算法单一文化”的影响取决于细节
items.title_en: The effects of an “algorithmic monoculture” depend on the details
items.title_original: The effects of an “algorithmic monoculture” depend on the details
items.what_happened: 麻省理工学院的研究人员于2026年9月29日发表了一项研究，聚焦招聘决策，发现“算法单一文化”的影响取决于细节。
items.what_happened_en: MIT researchers published a study on September 29, 2026, focusing on hiring decisions, finding that the effects of an 'algorithmic monoculture' depend on the details.
items.why_it_matters: 该研究强调了算法系统中细节的重要性，对招聘及其他领域的公平性和有效性具有启示意义。
items.why_it_matters_en: The study highlights the importance of details in algorithmic systems, with implications for fairness and effectiveness in hiring and beyond.

items.title_cn: NASA庆祝《阿尔忒弥斯协定》签署方超过75个
items.title_en: NASA Celebrates as Artemis Accords Surpasses 75 Signatories
items.title_original: NASA Celebrates as Artemis Accords Surpasses 75 Signatories - NASA
items.what_happened: NASA庆祝《阿尔忒弥斯协定》签署方超过75个。
items.what_happened_en: NASA celebrated as the Artemis Accords surpassed 75 signatories.
items.why_it_matters: 签署方数量的增长表明《阿尔忒弥斯协定》的国际参与度正在扩大。
items.why_it_matters_en: The growing number of signatories signals broadening international participation in the Artemis Accords.

items.title_cn: 网络有多快？用BEACON探索数十亿真实用户测量数据
items.title_en: How fast is the web? Explore billions of real-user measurements with BEACON
items.title_original: How fast is the web? Explore billions of real-user measurements with BEACON
items.what_happened: Cloudflare发布了Cloudflare BEACON数据集，称其为基于数十亿真实用户测量数据的浏览器体验数据。文章指出，终端用户可能面临老旧的低端手机、低电量、限速数据套餐、投资不足的公共基础设施或较差的Wi-Fi，而客观数据有助于缩小技术决策中的认知差距。
items.what_happened_en: Cloudflare published the Cloudflare BEACON dataset, described as Browser Experience data based on billions of real-user measurements. The post says end users may face older budget phones, low battery, throttled data plans, under-invested public infrastructure, or poor Wi-Fi, and that objective data can help close the perception gap in technology decisions.
items.why_it_matters: 该数据集为开发者和决策者提供了超越高端测试条件的真实网络性能视角。
items.why_it_matters_en: The dataset gives developers and decision-makers a real-world view of web performance beyond high-end test conditions.

items.title_cn: EmDash 1.0：带有安全插件注册表的稳定CMS
items.title_en: EmDash 1.0: the stable CMS with a secure plugin registry
items.title_original: EmDash 1.0: the stable CMS with a secure plugin registry
items.what_happened: Cloudflare发布了EmDash 1.0，这是一个基于Astro构建的稳定、免费且开源的CMS，并带有去中心化插件注册表。
items.what_happened_en: Cloudflare released EmDash 1.0, a stable, free, and open source CMS built on Astro, with a decentralized plugin registry.
items.why_it_matters: 它为开发者和网站所有者提供了一个生产就绪的开源CMS，并带有安全的插件注册表。
items.why_it_matters_en: It provides a production-ready open source CMS with a secure plugin registry for developers and site owners.

items.title_cn: NASA强调从Swift Boost任务中吸取的经验教训
items.title_en: NASA Highlights Lessons Learned From Swift Boost Mission
items.title_original: NASA Highlights Lessons Learned From Swift Boost Mission - NASA Science
items.what_happened: NASA强调了从Swift Boost任务中吸取的经验教训。
items.what_happened_en: NASA highlighted lessons learned from the Swift Boost Mission.
items.why_it_matters: 所吸取的经验教训可能为未来的太空任务规划和操作提供参考。
items.why_it_matters_en: The lessons learned may inform future space mission planning and operations.

items.title_cn: NASA与波音分享商业星际客机开发计划更新
items.title_en: NASA, Boeing Share Update on Commercial Starliner Development Plans
items.title_original: NASA, Boeing Share Update on Commercial Starliner Development Plans - NASA
items.what_happened: NASA和波音提供了商业星际客机航天器开发计划的更新。
items.what_happened_en: NASA and Boeing provided an update on the development plans for the commercial Starliner spacecraft.
items.why_it_matters: 该更新向公众和利益相关者通报了波音商业载人飞行器的状态。
items.why_it_matters_en: The update informs the public and stakeholders about the status of Boeing's commercial crew vehicle.

items.title_cn: 研究揭示新疆东天山青铜至铁器时代人群遗传历史
items.title_en: Study Reveals Genetic History of Bronze to Iron Age Populations in East Tianshan, Xinjiang
items.title_original: 研究揭示新疆东天山青铜至铁器时代人群遗传历史
items.what_happened: 中国科学院的一项研究揭示了新疆东天山青铜至铁器时代人群的遗传历史。
items.what_happened_en: A study by the Chinese Academy of Sciences revealed the genetic history of populations in East Tianshan, Xinjiang during the Bronze to Iron Age.
items.why_it_matters: 该发现有助于理解中亚地区古代人群迁徙与基因交流。
items.why_it_matters_en: The findings contribute to understanding ancient human migration and genetic exchange in Central Asia.

items.title_cn: 分子拓扑调控长程相干电荷输运研究取得进展
items.title_en: Progress in Molecular Topology Regulating Long-Range Coherent Charge Transport
items.title_original: 分子拓扑调控长程相干电荷输运研究取得进展
items.what_happened: 中国科学院研究人员在利用分子拓扑调控长程相干电荷输运方面取得进展。
items.what_happened_en: Researchers at the Chinese Academy of Sciences made progress in using molecular topology to regulate long-range coherent charge transport.
items.why_it_matters: 该工作推进了对分子体系中电荷输运的基础理解，对分子电子学具有潜在意义。
items.why_it_matters_en: The work advances fundamental understanding of charge transport in molecular systems, with potential implications for molecular electronics.
